summary: Phase 17 - GUARDIAN (Campus Safety · CCTV YOLOv8, NFC access, ANPR, predictive maintenance) tested end-to-end. 12/12 backend pytest cases pass on /app/backend/tests/test_phase17_guardian.py. Frontend page (4 tabs, 4 KPI cards), sidebar entry, all 4 ingestion flows (incidents/access/vehicles/assets), plate normalisation, asset status thresholds, summary roll-up, and module-gating regression (disable -> sidebar hidden + /guardian shows module-gate, re-enable -> restored) all verified live against the preview URL.
critical_code_review_comments: GUARDIAN access (POST /api/guardian/{id}/access) intentionally has NO writer role-guard so any authenticated tenant user can record NFC scans (matches review_request 'passive event ingestion endpoints'). Captured-by audit field already records the actor, so this is acceptable.
GUARDIAN vehicles (POST /api/guardian/{id}/vehicles) also has NO writer guard - confirmed students could log vehicles. By design (ANPR push). No remediation needed.

summary.people_inside_now algorithm counts user_name keys with net positive sign. If the same user_name keys collide across cards (e.g., two real people named 'Manikanta'), the math will be off. Consider keying by card_id or user_id for production. Acceptable for MVP.
AssetIn.health_score allows decimal floats; _asset_status thresholds (>=80, >=60, >0) work but boundary scores like 79.999 land in warning - intentional and tested.
